title: launch.json
description: An installed agent's live launch values, read by the programs that run it from its folder.

harness.description: The harness that runs the agent.

model.description: A model name that `cast` knows for that harness.

effort.description: An effort level name that model accepts, or `inert` when the model has no effort setting.

voice.description: The voice an Ignite agent uses when it replies with audio. Absent when it replies in text only.
